scope.attribution: Comparison includes optimizations merged in PR #982 through the display-promotion correction at 0f925b8d; additive production change is a 21-line finite-reference cache guard.

environment.timingConditions: Final measurements ran serially after competing compilation finished; small dependency bookkeeping overlapped an excluded early native warmup only.

excludedTrials.reason: Initial CPU-contended exploratory trials were discarded; only final quiet native and paired WASM runs are retained.

evidenceLayout.rawRecords: All native JSONL records and all eight WASM results.json payloads, including warmups and source records, are retained.
evidenceLayout.comparison: Original comparison and manifest data retained with machine-specific paths replaced by portable location identifiers.
evidenceLayout.artifactReferences: Original snapshot filenames and hashes are provenance records; the snapshot payloads are not embedded in this compact evidence file.

native.laterRetentionFixApplicability: The later display-cache promotion correction changes only an opt-in face-mesh cache that this native probe leaves disabled; retained native records keep their original e612 source provenance.
